Name: Strawdew Valley - CP
Author: chefrude
AuthorLabel: ChefRude w MinervaMaga ParadigmNomad F4ith and SDVDiscord gang
Description:
When [url=https://github.com/Antoninko]Antoninko[/url]﻿ requested a Texture replacement mod that [url=https://github.com/StardewModders/Modding-Ideas/issues/44]turns all NPCs into straws, and the wizard into a drink[/url]﻿, no one took them seriously.
But this it the kind of challenge I adore.

So... 

I present to you.... 

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/wzrGget.png[/img][/center]

Where all NPCs are (drinking) Straws and where the Wizard is the only drink.

﻿[b][u][color=#ff00ff][size=4]Install[/size][/color][/u][/b][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

There are no options for this Content Patcher mod. Everyone is a Straw/Drink. Period.
Look out for some easter eggs!

Happy Modding!

You can see a [b]video stream [/b]by Squasha and DrGluon playing "Cursed SDV" with this mod in it [url=https://youtu.be/0QP6H1-FCCQ]here[/url]

[u][b][size=4][color=#ff0000]Known Issues[/color][/size][/b][/u][list]
[*]Longevity + CP can fight, and Longevity tends to win. Typical modded sprites, such as marriable NPCs, will get longevity spritesheets and not CP spritesheets. If you notice that some NPCs don't make the change, Longevity is the reason.
[/list]
[size=2]Thanks to the SDV Discord community for testing and helping me complete this mod. ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/26612284]ParadigmNomad[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/7187759]F4ith[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/51777556]Minervamaga[/url]﻿ in particular. Oh and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/44734342?tab=user+files]Cat[/url] for making the awesome logo!)[/size]
